proxy_address.description: The IP address or hostname for the proxytrack proxy to bind to.

proxy_port.description: The TCP port for the proxytrack proxy to bind to.

icp_address.description: The IP address or hostname for the ICP daemon. Leave empty to disable ICP.

icp_port.description: The TCP port for the ICP daemon. Ignored if icp_address is empty.

caches.description: A list of paths to httrack cache zip files (e.g., /path/to/hts-cache/new.zip).
